author: kritbets
quote: After 10 hours of play, I unfortunately have to give this game a zero out of 10 because it's not a GTA game. This game undoubtedly deserves to exist and it's not a bad game for the right audience, but as a GTA game it is an absolute zero. This is not a GTA game this is something else wearing a GTA logo. It's a shame that they decided to do this, but this is my review and I'm not changing it. I wanted a GTA game and I waited over a decade for it. Instead I was given a slightly mundane cozy life simulator. I'm not even opposed to the idea of playing a cozy life simulator with or without elements of criminal activity. But I've been a massive GTA fan since GTA III and even ran GTA fan websites in the past. This ain't it, I'm sorry it's not. If that offends you, if you think I'm an incel, I don't care. I'm not going to entertain weaponized incompetence to the reasons why I didn't like this game. I've explained it. It's not GTA. It's something else.
